questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When riding in a group, riders use hand signals to communicate. When the lead rider extends their left arm straight out with their palm facing up and swings it upward, it tells other riders to increase their speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are permitted on an upcoming narrow bridge.
The bridge ahead is open to one-way traffic only.
The bridge ahead is wide enough for only one car at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert drivers to upcoming hazards and are typically yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the bridge ahead may be too narrow for you to safely meet or pass a truck.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a road crosses ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Riders can use hand signals instead of or in addition to turn signals. When a rider's left arm is bent at the elbow and points upward, it means they plan to turn right or change lanes to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs display traffic rules that drivers must follow. This sign means you can turn left at a green light, but you must yield to oncoming traffic and only complete the turn when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Slow down without coming to a complete stop.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: All eight-sided signs are stop signs. You must come to a complete stop and look both ways for pedestrians and vehicles. Only proceed when the intersection is clear.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer frequently cross the road in this area. Slow down, stay alert, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This sign shows where bicycles regularly cross or travel beside the road. Drive carefully in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The highway ahead curves only to the right.
The highway ahead turns sharply to the right.
The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
The highway ahead curves to the left and then to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert drivers to hazards ahead and are typically yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the road will curve right, then curve left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash through it means no. This sign means U-turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a yield sign. Slow down and check for traffic. Let pedestrians and other vehicles go first. Only stop if you need to.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells you that left turns are not allowed in this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows you which direction traffic flows on a one-way street. You must drive in the direction the arrow points.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The group will pull off at the next exit.

questions.explanation: When the lead rider raises their left arm and points up with one finger, the group should line up in single file.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When a rider extends their left arm straight out, it means they plan to turn left or move into the left lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: An upcoming curve in the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming curve in the road.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road curves to the right ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean you must stop. Come to a complete stop and check for traffic before proceeding when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop, whether there’s a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children crossing the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Always let pedestrians cross safely. Watch carefully at intersections and crossings where children may be present, and be prepared to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that a sharp turn is coming. Reduce your speed before you reach the turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
The road ahead winds a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Slow down on wet pavement, avoid sudden braking or sharp turns, and keep more distance between you and other vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to a steep hill ahead. Slow down to protect your brakes and avoid a collision.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This lane is reserved only for left-turning vehicles from either direction. You cannot use it for passing or going straight.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to a curve in the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow diamond warning sign tells you that a divided highway is coming. The road will split into separate directions for each direction of traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a traffic signal is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly and sound your horn.
You are entering a school's parking lot.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that you are approaching a school zone. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep downhill grade is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic is merging in from the right side of the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign alerts you that a T intersection is ahead.
